direction.summary: Sobriedade institucional com evidência técnica editada: uma família (Archivo) e uma escala em todas as rotas; abertura que nomeia a atuação, dois caminhos e um desenho técnico demonstrativo legível; situações em lista regrada com rótulo de categoria e a vertical de obras públicas em bloco escuro; páginas de serviço com caixa "em 30 segundos", prova antes do método (figura + conta refazível + tabela com rolagem própria) e um bloco de contato por página.

design_principles: Cards are the exception, not the default section structure
Every section has one dominant element (claim, evidence, consequence, or action)
Technical materiality: timelines, matrices, decision gates — never invented metrics
Contrast with intent: white editorial, deep navy, near-black, neutral surfaces; green only as decision/action/protection signal
Typography hierarchy over decoration; mono only for technical evidence
Motion only to orient reading; respect prefers-reduced-motion

usage.green_100: Never default section background. Max one consecutive light-green surface in a page scroll.
usage.lime: Rare accent for status, emphasis in dark panels, or a single key number — not body text color.
usage.green_border: Only on primary actions, decision signals, or one featured block — not every card.

typography.serif_display: var(--sans) — a serifa de sistema saiu: a variante de display é a própria Archivo em wdth 96%
typography.mono: var(--sans) — códigos e IDs usam Archivo em wdth 78% com tabular-nums; nada de monoespaçada como fantasia técnica

scale.h1_hero: clamp(2rem, 1.35rem + 2.2vw, 2.75rem) — 32px em 390, 44px em 1440; nenhuma clamp local de h1 sobrevive em styles.css

rules: Strategic claims may use serif-display class for one line per section max
Do not rely only on Inter size changes for hierarchy
No critical text below 12.8px; body copy stays at or above 16px

font_files.fallback: Archivo Fallback (Arial/Liberation Sans/Helvetica) com size-adjust 98.56%, ascent-override 89.08%, descent-override 21.31%
font_files.delivered_by: css/identity.css → styles.css (todas as rotas desde 2026-09-16; antes só a home via assets/home-10x.css)

spacing.rule: Never apply the same vertical padding to every consecutive section; alternate tight/default/loose and surface contrast
spacing.scale_note: Escala em rem, que é a que os componentes usam. Antes desta versão o JSON declarava px (5=20, 6=24, 8=32) enquanto styles.css resolvia para rem (5=24, 6=32, 8=64), e o mesmo token valia coisas diferentes conforme a folha carregada. Os painéis foram desenhados contra a escala rem, então ela é a registrada; 10 e 12 seguem em rem equivalente aos 40px e 48px anteriores.

radii.rule: Raio é exceção: 8px em botões, campos e amostras; 12px só em painel de captura; nada de 16px+ em cartões

shadows.rule: Sem sombra difusa. Hierarquia por régua de 1px (--rule), peso tipográfico e contraste de superfície; a única sombra é o toque de 1px em campo/botão

section_archetypes.hero_split: Positioning + H1 + consequence + dual CTA + proprietary visual (not SaaS dashboard)
section_archetypes.tension_sequence: Numbered causal sequence with rising stakes; no equal cards
section_archetypes.model_radial: Central nucleus + linked vectors; not four identical cards
section_archetypes.offer_dominant: One large editorial offer + secondary situational paths
section_archetypes.journey_rail: Operational line with stages; all content accessible without JS
section_archetypes.authority_editorial: Photo + trajectory + fields of experience; no fake metrics
section_archetypes.trace_matrix: Method table: decision, premise, owner, risk, action, result, learning
section_archetypes.content_editorial: Featured + thematic trails, not six equal cards
section_archetypes.icp_contrast: Faz sentido / Não faz sentido as typographic contrast
section_archetypes.faq_compact: Dense Q&A with clear open state
section_archetypes.cta_formal: Memorable close + private form; not generic template form
section_archetypes.journey_paths: Three buyer journeys as first-class paths; not three equal cards
section_archetypes.compare_ladder: Comparable view of a product ladder: name, question answered, price and relation to the bundle, before any long section
section_archetypes.ladder_entry: Declared entry step of a ladder; the reason it opens the page is written, not implied by extra length
section_archetypes.ladder_top: Declared top of a ladder; distinct composition, same depth as the peers
section_archetypes.deliverable_feature: One deliverable as editorial feature: promise, input/output, price, one action
section_archetypes.reading_method: Numbered reading criteria that apply to the whole library, not to a single item
section_archetypes.ladder_credit: Ladder arithmetic and credit rule on an authority surface
section_archetypes.catalog_index: Taxative full-catalog index grouped by visitor task, with canonical state, price, SLA, evidence boundary and one terminal action per available item
section_archetypes.market_context: Public market records labeled as market context, never as CONFENGE client proof
section_archetypes.analysis_masthead: Technical-analysis masthead: editorial class label, H1, the not-a-client-case caveat and the publication state of the page
section_archetypes.analysis_abstract: Executive summary of the analysis: the conclusion that is possible, in short prose, before any evidence
section_archetypes.analysis_relevance: Why this public contract deserves an analysis; a selection criterion, not a commercial promise
section_archetypes.analysis_argument: Continuous prose body, used only when the record needs development beyond the epistemic lists
section_archetypes.evidence_record: Instrument record: identification table for the contract, built from a public source
section_archetypes.evidence_timeline: Dated timeline of the contract events
section_archetypes.evidence_claims: FACT-tracked claims, each with source, locator and hash
section_archetypes.evidence_calculation: Calculations with explicit method and result, kept apart from the facts
section_archetypes.evidence_comparables: Public comparables consumed, or the declared reason for consuming none
section_archetypes.editorial_interpretation: CONFENGE technical interpretation, labelled as inference and never mixed into the facts
section_archetypes.epistemic_boundary: What cannot be concluded from the available evidence
section_archetypes.source_ledger: Ledger of public sources with reference date and scope
section_archetypes.method_disclosure: Method and gate version that produced the page, signed by the technical owner
section_archetypes.limitation_notice: Declared limitations of the scope, the data and the reach of the analysis
section_archetypes.maintenance_owner: Named owner of the page update
section_archetypes.update_log: Dated history of update and correction
section_archetypes.related_assets: Related useful assets, chosen by visitor task and not by link volume
section_archetypes.contextual_next_action: Contextual next step on an editorial surface: one action, without restating the offer in another table
section_archetypes.provenance_hashes: Hashes and provenance binding the page to its evidence pack
section_archetypes.correction_channel: Public channel for correction and contestation
section_archetypes.author_identity: Named author and technical owner, with a verifiable trajectory

component_usage_rules.icons: Only for specific actions/concepts; never decorate every heading; never icon-in-circle on every section

budget_notes.font: Delta revisado de 2026-08-30 (canario de direcao visual na home): 0 -> 1 arquivo e 0 -> 60 KB gzip. O arquivo e Archivo v2.001 (Omnibus-Type, SIL OFL 1.1), subconjunto latino pt-BR, dois eixos com faixa reduzida ao que o CSS usa (wght 100-900, wdth 66-110) e tnum + zero ligados, medido em 58.7 KB. O eixo de largura custa ~34 KB e e a propria historia tipografica da direcao: rotulo de coluna condensado, titulo em 84% e linha de virada em 110%. Fixar wdth cairia para 24 KB e devolveria a home a uma grotesca de largura unica, que e o que a campanha existe para evitar. Servido de assets/archivo-var-latin-bf6e041e.woff2 e carregado apenas na home por assets/home-10x.css. O subconjunto cobre o vocabulario aritmetico da casa (m2, m3, +-, 1/2, (c), (r)), porque glifo ausente nao levanta erro: renderiza noutra fonte em silencio. Verificado por scripts/site/test_font_glyph_coverage.py. Os tetos do modulo nao se movem: FONT_FILES_CAP=6 e FONT_GZIP_CAP_KB=120 em scripts/site/audit_performance.py, entao um segundo webfont nao declarado continua reprovando.
budget_notes.cls: Enforced twice from this one key: scripts/site/lighthouse_thresholds.mjs applies it to the live headless-Chrome run CI performs on the built _site, and scripts/site/audit_performance.py applies it to the committed rows in docs/lighthouse-runs/summary.json. Observed baseline is 0.000 on every measured route.
budget_notes.content_bytes: Orcamento de conteudo das rotas criticas (150 KiB = 153.600 bytes): soma dos corpos COMPRIMIDOS de toda resposta de primeira parte que a pagina carrega, medidos no fio pelo mesmo codigo no gate local e no aceite de runtime (scripts/site/lighthouse_payload.mjs). Nao inclui cabecalhos de resposta: o total-byte-weight do Lighthouse os inclui e, na borda canonica, uma CSP de 5,3 KB em cada asset fez o mesmo artefato medir 153.642 localmente e 201.033 ao vivo em 2026-09-10 (run 34501989732). Cabecalhos por resposta sao contrato do host e tem gate proprio (validate-nginx.mjs). Numero inalterado desde a origem do gate; o teto CONTENT_BYTES_CAP em lighthouse_thresholds.mjs impede afrouxar sem commit revisado.
budget_notes.lcp: LCP maximo das rotas criticas (2.000 ms) sob a simulacao movel do Lighthouse, aplicado ao caminho de renderizacao do artefato. No gate local a origem e http://127.0.0.1 com latencia de servidor submilissegundo. No aceite de runtime a simulacao soma a latencia de servidor OBSERVADA na borda (network-server-latency, mediana da execucao: dezenas de ms, geografia runner -> borda -> origem), que nao e o artefato; ela e registrada como folga explicita (lcp_network_allowance_ms), com teto de 250 ms e zero quando nao medida, nunca somada ao numero do orcamento. metrics.timeToFirstByte NAO e usado: e o TTFB simulado do Lantern (~450 ms), igual no laboratorio e na borda. O Chrome do runner desliga QUIC porque o simulador so modela multiplexacao para h2 e tratava h3 como HTTP/1.1 com handshake por conexao (+~300 ms na borda). Numero inalterado; teto LCP_MS_CAP em lighthouse_thresholds.mjs.
